reviews.summary: Memory.tsx now imports InfoButton, the import that was named as the Sheet import (actually InfoSheet) is gone, and the info/setInfo state, the hand-built button, the InfoSheet element and the onInfo handler are all removed. It renders exactly one <InfoButton> element (const infoButton). At any time it appears in only one place: the bar on wide windows, the net header or the list search on the phone. InfoButton supplies aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-label={T.info.open(title)}, which is the same pattern every other InfoButton in the app uses. The testIds stay as they were: memory-info for the button and memory-info-sheet for the sheet, which the existing e2e tests rely on. Three files the order didn't name also changed: KnowledgeNet and NetHeader now take an `info` node in place of `onInfo`, and the CSS selector was changed to match. These changes were needed so the phone's (i) can sit in the net header. They are consistent, NetHeader's duplicate hand-built button was removed, and no dead code or new files are left. npm test exited 0.
